sources.title: How to use milestone checklists
sources.scope: Checklists support communication and monitoring; they are not developmental standards, screening, diagnosis, or a curriculum.

sources.title: Milestones at 1 year
sources.scope: Age-specific monitoring and parent tips; never infer an individual child has or lacks a skill.

sources.title: Milestones at 30 months
sources.scope: Use for caregiver questions and discussion, not a target list to drill.

sources.title: Milestones at 5 years
sources.scope: Examples of development and parent tips; not a readiness test or a child assessment.

sources.organization: Harvard Center on the Developing Child
sources.title: Executive function activity guide
sources.scope: Adult-supported play suggestions organized by age, including 6–18 months, 18–36 months, 3–5 and 5–7 years. Our variants are adaptations, not evaluated protocols.

sources.organization: Harvard Center on the Developing Child
sources.title: Serve and return
sources.scope: Notice children’s cues, respond, name experiences and leave room for a response. Do not prescribe a number of exchanges or promise a developmental effect.

sources.title: Preparing Young Children for School
sources.scope: Pre-K guidance covers social-emotional learning, executive function, math, vocabulary, letters/sounds and shared reading. Source evidence ratings apply to its recommendations and population, not our exact home games or younger children.

sources.title: The Power of Play
sources.scope: Play and interaction offer learning opportunities; adapt to the child and follow interest. No promised acceleration or measured gain.

sources.organization: ZERO TO THREE / American Institutes for Research
sources.title: Math4Littles
sources.scope: Playful counting, spatial ideas, patterns, shapes and measurement for two- and three-year-olds. Adjust challenge without emphasizing mistakes.

sources.title: Family resources
sources.scope: Entry point for shared reading, age-appropriate book selection and booklists. Read a linked leaf before attributing detailed advice to it.

sources.title: Resources for families
sources.scope: Discovery hub for play, language, math and other early learning topics; not one study or an evidence rating.
